column4: Pixel-art game character sprites in exactly the same style as the reference image, a mid-1990s Build-engine game: the same coarse pixel size, the same limited palette, the same shading and the same dark outline. A character turnaround model sheet: five full-body views of one and the same person standing perfectly still, arms hanging straight down, side by side in a single row, evenly spaced with clear magenta gaps between them, all exactly the same height and scale with the feet on one common baseline near the bottom edge: (1) seen straight from the front, (2) a three-quarter view from the front with the body turned toward the right edge of the image, (3) an exact side profile facing the right edge of the image, (4) a three-quarter view from behind, turned away toward the right edge of the image so the back and the right shoulder show, (5) seen straight from behind, the back of the head and the back of the clothes. Every figure is exactly the woman in the reference image, with the same face, body, proportions, clothes and colours: sallow skin, long blonde curly hair, a red cap, gold hoop earrings, a black mini dress, one red high heel, the other foot bare and black with mud; her legs and neck slightly too long, a grin of sharp teeth under hard scowling brows, eyes black hollows with one tiny white point each. Eerie and unsettling, an enemy in a horror game. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around and between the figures, no ground, no floor line, no shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers, no grid lines, no frames, no borders, no watermark.

Pixel-art sprite exactly in the style, pixel size, palette and lighting of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, no text. The SAME woman with EXACTLY the same colours as the reference: the same sallow skin, blonde curly hair, red cap, black dress, gold hoops, one red high heel and the other foot bare and black with mud; NO red or pink on her cheeks at all, nothing recoloured. Almost human, but not: uncanny, not a monster costume. Her eyebrows drawn down hard into a furious scowl while her mouth grins wide with rows of small sharp teeth and strings of drool; eyes black hollows with one tiny white point each; her legs and neck slightly too long. Full body seen from BEHIND: her back, the blonde hair, the back of the black dress and her heels, but her head turned all the way round so her scowling grinning face looks straight at the viewer over her spine; her arms hanging down too long, past her knees, standing perfectly still.
